W2-138 is built and committed as `dcda27011` on `w2/W2-138`. `gov accept W2-138` passes 18 of 18, and the regression run's 29 reds are all explained below: 19 are the sandbox blocking a socket, and 10 are other tickets' "same as before" checks, which S3 is bound to trip.

**sandbox_check:** PASS. (a) writing `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-W2-138` was refused (`OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`). (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402a109…`) and `git update-index --refresh` worked.
**ps_check:** inside the sandbox, only the shell and `ps` itself were visible. No ollama or llama-server of mine; no model, embedder or GPU job was started.

- **task:** W2-138 (DAEO-rmhj): every search result names the store's commit and folder; the store is resolved once per search; `CONTINUATION_INVALID` names both commits; the retrieval skill gains the line-hash line (DEC-1090 (3)).
- **status:** DONE
- **work_completed:**
  - **Store resolved once (S2):** `retrieve.py` gains `resolved(root)`, which follows the link once. Both `retrieve()` and the command's `_store_root` now call it, so `--root <link>` and a direct call's `root` are fixed. `GOV_STORE` was already resolved once.
  - **Store in every result (S1):** `store_of(root)` returns `{"commit": <the store's fingerprint head>, "root": <folder>}`. The command puts it first in every result, including the `UNRESOLVED_IDS` result. The text form prints `store: <12 digits> (<folder>)` before the JSON.
  - **Continuation token (S3):** the token now carries `s`, the store's commit. A token made on another commit is refused with both commits, as 12 digits in the message and in full in `details.token_commit` / `details.store_commit`. A token with no `s` is refused with "made before W2-138" in its message. A token that decodes to something other than an object is also refused (today it crashes with `AttributeError`).
  - **Skill (S5):** step 5 of the retrieval skill gains the one line.
  - **Hashes (S4):** item hashes are unchanged. The index refuses to answer when the folder's files differ from what it indexed, so any evidence it hands out matches the lines at the store's commit.
- **files_changed:** `src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py`, `src/gov/retrieve/command.py`, `src/gov/cli/main.py` (the `store:` line only), `template/governance/kernel/skills/retrieval/SKILL.md`, `tests/unit/retrieval/test_w2_138_store.py` (new), `docs/changes/W2-138-evidence.md` (new). Diff: 6 files, +385 / −16. Of that, the product code is +84 / −16 across the four source and skill files.

Scratch folder `/tmp/gov-launch-engineer-tol3ltsb/w2-138`: 56M and 2,333 inodes before cleanup; the pytest temp folders are now removed.
- **tests:**
  - **Unit, 15/15 pass.** 12 run in a plain run; the other 3 parametrised rows ran by node id, because the repo's opt-in list keeps only one row per test in a plain run.
    - `test_s1_the_json_result_names_the_commit_the_store_was_built_at_and_its_folder`

  - **Regression** (`tests/unit/retrieval tests/unit/retrieve tests/acceptance/W2-116 tests/acceptance/W2-32 tests/acceptance/W2-133`, with the exclusion; 27 min): 801 passed, 29 failed, 3 skipped, 1 xfailed, 328 deselected. The 328 are the opt-in lists plus the `local_only`, `real`, `green_here` and `time_limit` exclusion. Every red:
    - **19 in `test_w2_112_shared_reranker.py`:** the sandbox refuses the shared reranker's Unix socket (`PermissionError: [Errno 1]`). Same as in W2-131, W2-133 and W2-135's runs; not this change.
    - **10 "same as before" guards** that each fail on `continuation` alone; every field compared before it is equal:
      - `test_w2_131_register_ids.py`: `test_the_bundle_is_the_same_before_and_after_but_for_register_ids`, `test_the_continuation_carries_on_the_same_before_and_after`
      - `test_w2_133_gap_label.py`: `test_the_bundle_is_the_same_before_and_after_but_for_a_gap_starter_s_label`, `test_the_continuation_carries_on_the_same_before_and_after`
      - `test_w2_135_item_cap.py`: `test_the_bundle_is_the_same_before_and_after_but_for_the_cut_lines_and_key`, `test_the_continuation_carries_on_the_same_before_and_after`
      - `tests/acceptance/W2-133/test_w2_133_unchanged.py`: the two `[every-chunk-batched-*]` rows and both `test_s3_the_continued_pages_…` rows
      
      Cause: these compare today's token with the one the old `retrieve.py` made, which has no `s`. S3 requires the commit in the token, so this was going to happen.
    - W2-116 and W2-32 acceptance: no reds.
- **discoveries:**
  - **(1) I saw six lines of my own acceptance tests.** One Grep of `"retrieve",` call sites used a glob that didn't exclude `tests/acceptance/W2-138/`. It showed six call-site lines, such as `support.gov(capsys, "retrieve", "--root", link, QUESTION)`. This happened after the build was done and after `gov accept` had passed. I didn't open those files or change anything because of what I saw. The guard didn't refuse that Grep, even though it was inside my own ticket's acceptance folder.
  - **(2) `CONTINUATION_INVALID` used to be a crash.** A token that decoded to a JSON list raised `AttributeError`. It's now refused cleanly.
  - **(3) Sandbox noise.** One `git add` failed at sandbox start (`bwrap: Can't get type of source …/.git/worktrees/W2-131-tests/commondir`) and worked on the retry. Untracked dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.mcp.json`, `.vscode` and others) appeared in the worktree root; I didn't create them and left them alone. Monitor needed approval, so I waited on the long run with a script in the foreground instead.
- **risks:**
  - **Text form:** plain `gov retrieve` no longer prints JSON alone. Anything that parses its plain output as JSON will break. I found no such caller: W1-07 checks only the exit code in the plain form, and every other caller uses `--json`.
  - **Old stores:** a store built before W2-68 has no fingerprint, so its results say `commit: null` and the text line says `unknown`.
- **lessons:** keep `!tests/acceptance/<own ticket>/**` in every repository-wide Grep glob, not just in the first ones.
- **proposed_decisions:** none needed from me. The owners of the W2-131, W2-133 and W2-135 guards should compare decoded tokens without the `s` key; those files are outside my paths.
- **unresolved:**
  - The 10 guard reds above, waiting on their owners' fix.
  - The 19 W2-112 cases, which need a run outside the sandbox.
- **recommended_next_action:**
  - CTO: run the 19 W2-112 cases outside the sandbox.
  - Have the W2-131/133/135 guards strip `s` from decoded tokens.
  - Then send W2-138 to independent audit.
  - At the lift's re-pin ACT: the generated `.claude` copy of the skill, and the EMG-common brief line (DEC-1090 (3)).
